idea-plugin.name: Inline Console
idea-plugin.description: Shows console.log, console.warn and console.error values at the end of the line that produced them, plus an Inline Console tool window with every entry and its file:line link. Works with Vite, Next.js and plain Node apps through the inline-console npm package. Hover a value to see every value that line logged, in full, with copy. Vite and Next.js projects connect with no config change (Auto-Connect, on by default in the tool window).
